Container.Name: marginalia
Container.Overview: Discord book-club bot for one server: monthly cycles, nomination polls, a weekly checkpoint schedule with reminders and a discussion thread per checkpoint, and spoiler-gated quoting from an EPUB. Built locally from /mnt/cache/appdata/marginalia (deploy/unraid-install.sh rebuilds and recreates it). No ports: the bot connects OUT to Discord. Database lives in /mnt/cache/appdata/marginalia/data -- keep it on /mnt/cache, never /mnt/user. Watchdog and daily backup run from root's crontab.

Config.Name: Data (database)
Config.Description: SQLite database + WAL sidecars. MUST stay on /mnt/cache (direct disk): /mnt/user is FUSE and corrupts SQLite WAL.

Config.Name: Calibre library (read-only)
Config.Description: Optional. Lets /ingest-library pick books straight out of Calibre instead of uploading a file. READ-ONLY on purpose: the bot copies the EPUB out and must never be able to change or delete the library. /mnt/user here is deliberate and is NOT the database rule - this is someone else's library, opened read-only, and /mnt/user is what Calibre-Web-Automated itself mounts, so the two always see the same books. Leave blank if you have no Calibre.

Config.Name: DISCORD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot -> Reset Token). The only secret.

Config.Name: GUILD_ID
Config.Description: Your Discord server's ID (right-click the server icon -> Copy Server ID; needs Developer Mode).

Config.Name: BOOK_CLUB_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: The one channel the club lives in (right-click the channel -> Copy Channel ID).

Config.Name: CLUB_TZ
Config.Description: The club's timezone (IANA name). /schedule at:19:00 means 19:00 here; readers still see their own local time.

Config.Name: MARGINALIA_DB
Config.Description: Database path INSIDE the container. Leave as is.

Config.Name: CALIBRE_LIBRARY
Config.Description: Calibre library path INSIDE the container. Leave as is, or blank to disable /ingest-library.
